theme: session nonce GETLOGIN dual + ENTROPY hex mint

weaknesses.title: GETLOGIN vs USER dual under-documented for su/$USER override
weaknesses.detail: Agents using only USER miss session utmp identity; only USER miss setuid/login divergence. No LOGIN_EQ_USER helper.

weaknesses.title: ENTROPY silent clamp to 256 bytes — no overflow warn
weaknesses.detail: ENTROPY 9999 → 512 hex OK=1. Agents requesting 1KB token think they got 9999 bytes. No ENTROPY_CLAMPED bit.

weaknesses.title: Hex-only output — no base64/raw form
weaknesses.detail: Tokens double size vs binary. No ENTROPY_B64. Agents chain HEXD for binary.

weaknesses.title: GETLOGIN empty edge on non-session (daemon) soft-fail model unclear
weaknesses.detail: Proof asserts non-empty; daemons without utmp may OK=0 or empty. Agents lack portable fallback path docs.

weaknesses.title: HAS on hex tokens is alphabet false-friend
weaknesses.detail: HAS token a often 1; cannot validate charset with HAS. No ISHEX helper.

weaknesses.title: ENTROPY vs UUID dual purpose confusion
weaknesses.detail: UUID dashed fixed layout; ENTROPY pure hex. Agents mix formats in same plate without type stamp.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: VAL short hex glue in cat -A.

workarounds: Prefix tokens with type=entropy or type=uuid
issues_faced: selftest 272/272; no language fix this iter
